verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official `pplx` command-line interface for running web search from the terminal or a coding agent. It returns structured JSON ready for shell pipelines and agent tool calls, which fits AI-native workflows directly. The CLI as evidenced is scoped to the Search API (ranked results and snippets), and the docs say little about install, auth or command depth; missing for 10: CLI coverage of the Agent/Sonar answer and other APIs, detailed install/auth/command reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
